_meta.freeze: PCA generation instrument v1 (owner round-15 four verifications)
_meta.authorization: round-15: after the four verifications are recorded, launch per frozen protocol without a further principle-approval round

V1_frozen_objects.load_rule: generation and scoring scripts MUST load files from these paths and MUST re-verify sha256 at load time; any mismatch aborts before generation

constraints: operator names in model output are neither rewarded nor penalized (semantic scoring only)

retrieval.model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (revision hash recorded at execution into pca_retrieval_v1.json)
retrieval.card_render: {operator_id} | {description} | inputs: {normalized inputs} -> outputs: {normalized outputs} | params: {mandatory params: name(type), truncated at 12 params}
retrieval.freezing: one-shot materialization into pca_retrieval_v1.json (per-task top-15 ids + scores + rendered card text) BEFORE first generation; SHA recorded; shared by all arms/runs; never recomputed at run time

model.base: /home/qy/models/Qwen3.5/Qwen3.5-9B-Base (tokenizer same path; weight fingerprint recorded at load into run ledger)
model.adapter_B_C: /home/qy/stage1_run_planner_v2_fmt/stage1_adapter (frozen; file SHA ledger recorded at load)

termination_health.note: termination quality is a MEASURED capability signal; no termination fixes applied

arm_Bprime_diag.purpose: format-sensitivity diagnostic ONLY (never enters main comparison)
arm_Bprime_diag.prompt: B-group frozen task text + training-format separator (below) -> Blueprint JSON -> deterministic restatement to semantic steps via frozen translator
arm_Bprime_diag.separator: Workflow blueprint: output JSON with keys stages (ordered semantic stages with per-stage repeat counts) and repetition_groups (groups with repeat>1, each with iteration_hint from: per_band, per_class, per_year, per_feature, generic_each, unspecified).
arm_Bprime_diag.expansion_rule: if arm-B content_assessable_rate < 0.70 over the 60 main tasks -> extend B' to all B tasks (mechanical, preregistered)

seeds.strategy: greedy decoding is deterministic; seed 20261013 governs retrieval tie-breaks and human-review sampling (both preregistered)

retry.hardware_retry: OOM/CUDA/transient errors: up to 2 retries, each recorded with attempt number in run ledger
retry.semantic_non_retry: hit_cap / degenerate loops / empty content are MEASURED signals — never retried
retry.first_result_rule: first successful completion is the recorded result; retries never overwrite

counting_conventions.cache: no caching — every generation is an independent recorded attempt
counting_conventions.multi_sampling: one sample per (task, arm) — no temperature sampling
counting_conventions.retry_counting: hardware retries logged separately; do NOT inflate the 183 count
counting_conventions.W056058: GENERATED and SCORED for diagnostics; EXCLUDED from main scoring denominator (ledger field consumed)

V4_discipline.layout: outputs/{arm}/{task_id}/run_{run_id}.json (raw) — arms never share files; overwriting foreign outputs forbidden
V4_discipline.raw_readonly: raw model outputs are read-only after write; parse, score, and human-review stores are separate files
V4_discipline.immutability: after first formal result: no prompt/retrieval-card/gold/scoring-rule modification; defects -> versioned amendment per protocol

exclusions.P06: structural_exploratory — excluded from main pairing aggregation
